title: Brumaro - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Brumaro in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Brumaro is a physical-element weapon used by Monoco. It scales with Vitality (D), Agility (C).

sections.title: How to Get the Brumaro
sections.content:
Location: Stone Wave Cliffs cave.

Obtained from Stone Wave Cliffs cave.

sections.title: Is the Brumaro Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Vitality (D), Agility (C). A physical-scaling weapon, so it fits any build that is not committed to a specific element.
